events.name: node.created
events.description: A node was created through the API. Names the properties supplied, never their values.

events.name: node.rejected
events.description: A node write was refused by the ontology. Names the fields at fault, never their values.

events.name: edge.created
events.description: An edge was created through the API.

events.name: graph.store.failed
events.description: A graph store operation failed for a reason other than the domain refusing it, such as Neo4j being unreachable.

events.name: http.request.rejected
events.description: A request was refused with 400 because its arguments could not be read.

events.name: ingest.deployment.received
events.description: The deploy pipeline reported a deployment, which was applied.

events.name: ingest.seed.received
events.description: The dogfood seed posted a batch, which was applied.

events.name: ingest.unauthorized
events.message: ingest refused without a valid token
events.description: Someone posted to an ingest endpoint without the ingest token.

events.name: ontology.constraints.ensured
events.description: The store has a uniqueness constraint on the key of every node type.

events.name: ontology.version.recorded
events.description: The ontology version this instance runs was written to the graph.

events.name: connector.scheduled
events.description: A connector will sync on a schedule.

events.name: connector.schedule.skipped
events.description: A scheduled sync did not start, and why.

events.name: connector.run.failed
events.description: A sync run failed as a whole.

events.name: connector.page.failed
events.message: connector page failed; the run is partial
events.description: A connector failed to read one page, so its run is partial.

events.name: connector.page.unapplied
events.message: connector page could not be applied
events.description: A page a connector read could not be written to the graph.

events.name: connector.delivery.duplicate
events.description: A webhook delivery had already been applied by an earlier run, so nothing changed.

events.name: connector.webhook.failed
events.description: A verified webhook could not be applied.

events.name: sync.started
events.description: A connector began a run, scheduled, manual or from a webhook.

events.name: sync.page
events.description: A page a connector read was written to the graph. Pages count from 1.

events.name: sync.finished
events.description: A run ended, with how it ended, how long it took and what it wrote.

events.name: github.unreachable
events.description: The GitHub health check could not reach GitHub.

events.name: github.retrying
events.description: A GitHub request failed in a way worth retrying.

events.name: github.rate.limited
events.message: waiting for the GitHub rate limit to reset
events.description: GitHub's rate limit was reached; the connector waits for it rather than failing.

events.name: github.webhook.ignored
events.description: A GitHub webhook of a type the connector does not use.

events.name: github.webhook.malformed
events.message: verified GitHub webhook was not JSON
events.description: A GitHub webhook passed its signature check but its body could not be read.

events.name: github.dependencies.deferred
events.description: Dependencies on repositories not yet known were deferred to a later sync.

events.name: github.file.unreadable
events.description: A manifest or IaC file could not be read; the repository is still recorded.

events.name: github.file.skipped
events.description: A file was too large to read.

events.name: servicenow.unreachable
events.description: The ServiceNow health check could not reach ServiceNow.

events.name: servicenow.health.refused
events.description: ServiceNow answered the health check with a refusal, usually of the credentials.

events.name: servicenow.retrying
events.description: A ServiceNow request failed in a way worth retrying.

events.name: servicenow.remote.invalid
events.message: CI names something that is not a git remote
events.description: A configuration item's repository field is not a git remote, so no link is written.

events.name: servicenow.link.unresolved
events.message: no repository for the CI's link
events.description: A configuration item names a repository the graph does not hold, so no link is written.
